Marie Leszczyńska (born June 23, 1703, Breslau, Silesia—died June 24, 1768, 
Versailles, France) was the queen 
consort of King 
Louis XV of 
France (ruled 1715–74). Although she had no direct influence on French politics, her Polish dynastic connections involved France in a European conflict that resulted in the eventual annexation of Lorraine by France.
